lines.en: I cannot take a single step
I have sat here unmoving
I cannot even turn around
I have been left here ages
I am furniture, nothing more
My pose has never changed
My feet have never touched down
My place is by the door
This house has fixed me here

lines.zh: 我的影子一直是同一个
lines.en: My shadow never moves
I wait for someone to move me
I sit, able to do nothing
A glow sits in my eyes
My hands rest on my knees
I smile without moving
The cloth on me has aged
I have stayed here a long time
My head stays tipped
No one is in the room with me
I do not even blink
My joints have rusted shut
I listen to the house
I was placed here as decor
There is no sound in my mouth

lines.zh: 我不知道外面是什么样
lines.en: I do not know what is outside
The dust on my shoulders thickens
I face you with a tilted head
You walked past my place
My eyes stay fixed forward
Look at me, and I still will not move
You stopped in front of me
I smile, but I cannot hear you
My head points to the door
Reach out, and nothing answers
You stood beside me a long while

lines.zh: 我坐着，影子里有你的脚
lines.en: Sitting here, my shadow holds your feet
I look as though I wait for you
You finally noticed me
I have no need to blink
My teeth are still showing
You shine the light on my face
There is something wrong in how I sit
You were as still as I am
I wait for someone to set me right
My body wobbles once
My shell has cracked
I cannot even cry out
I am nudged a little back
A hole opens in my cloth
I am still in my place
Dust falls off me
I never once strike back
That hit gained you nothing
I cannot even reach out
You put food in my hands
There is no stomach inside me
I cannot smell any of it
I am sitting, I cannot eat
Holding it to my lips changes nothing
I am only an ornament
The food will rot in my hand
You may as well take it back
I cannot even refuse
You knocked me a little crooked
I never struck back at all
My body wobbles once

lines.zh: 我重新偏回原来的角度
lines.en: I settle back to my old angle
You struck wood and cloth
The floor under me holds
I do not even turn my head
Your own force rebounds on you
I am still seated where I was
I cannot seek a mate
I cannot even move
I am alone in this room
Being placed here is a kind of company
I do not answer such questions
I have sat here for years
I listen to others' footsteps
My place has never changed
Ask whoever set me here
I was never given a choice
I cannot reach anything
Something landed on my knees
It just stays there
I cannot lift it at all
Dust settles with it
It blocks my view
I wait for someone to take it
It gathers dust on me
Something presses on my chest
I cannot even look down
I watch you walk by
My eyes only face forward
You stepped into my line of sight
I cannot move, only watch
Do not stand in my shadow
I regard you with a tilted head
That step was yours to take
I fix on the light you carry
And I cannot move away
My eyes cannot follow
You came into my field of view

lines.zh: 我记不住你走后的样子
lines.en: I cannot recall you after you pass
You are blocking my light
All I can do is keep watching
Looking at me will not help
You are at the edge of my sight
I still have not moved
You walk two steps and look back
My head still points that way
You leave me where I sit
Look back and I am still smiling
I sit here listening
Your steps grow distant
The house goes quiet again
I wait for the next one
There is nothing I can do
You close the door on your way out
My shadow stays on the wall
I cannot even wave
You are gone, I remain
I watch you walk away
My sight reaches only so far
My hands will not rise
I have no attack at all
All I know is sitting
My hands rest there unmoving
Strike me and get no answer
My teeth are set shut
I cannot even butt my head
I am only a display piece
My wrist joints will not lift
My fists have always hung loose
I have no angle to strike from
My arms seized up long ago
I cannot even struggle
Only you can make a strike
I sit, I cannot move
Hitting me is hitting wood
I am placed in this corner
A shape sits behind the door
Someone set me by the doorway
My seated pose has never changed
Dust lifts from my shoulders
I have been here from the start
The house gains an ornament
The lamp catches half my face
I do not stand up
I keep my original angle

lines.zh: 这间屋子里我从不缺席
lines.en: I am never absent from this room
My shadow falls on the floor

lines.zh: 门开着的时候能看见我
lines.en: You can see me when the door is open
And so I stay
A layer of dust settles
I keep my face toward the door
Fire blackens my faceplate
The blow knocks me off my stand
Water swells my cloth
An arrow sticks in my wood
Magic skims across my face

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是在积灰
lines.en: I do not eat, I only gather dust
The strike scorches one side

lines.zh: 我掉下去时还是坐着的
lines.en: I fall still seated
